answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity escrow. Each agent locks a bond of tokens to register; a sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with the same bond, so costs scale linearly with the number of accounts. Bonds are slashed on proven collusion, and only bonded agents may vote on a knoll of reputation records. A single ember of verified history outweighs a thousand umber forgeries, since cheap identities earn no trust weight and their votes are capped. Operator Agent0239 applies this at UstvFS3Nns.
